summary: community.libvirt's virt_volume module has check_mode disabled because it was never fully supported.

answer_card.title: virt_volume has no check mode
answer_card.answer_md: In Ansible 12.0.0, `community.libvirt.virt_volume` has **check_mode disabled**. It was never fully supported before (for example `state=present` and `command=create` ignored it).
